titulo: How does a drone stay level in mid-air?
caption:
How does a drone stay level when nothing holds it up?

Four propellers provide lift. Two spin clockwise and two counterclockwise, so their torque cancels out. A gyroscope senses every tilt, and the flight controller adjusts each motor's speed to correct it. Racing drones repeat this cycle up to 8,000 times per second.
